summary: Analytics dashboard on Insights page passed QA review.

checks.name: Stat cards
checks.details: Four stat cards: Total Tasks, Completed, In Progress, Failed. Color-coded with appropriate text colors.

checks.name: Completion rate bar
checks.details: Gradient bar from blue to green showing completion percentage. Rounded full width bar.

checks.name: Phase distribution
checks.details: Segmented bar showing phase distribution by count. Legend below with color dots and labels. Uses PHASE_COLORS map for consistent coloring.

checks.name: Empty state
checks.details: When no tasks exist, shows 'No tasks yet' message instead of broken stats.

checks.name: Dark mode
checks.details: All components use dark theme colors matching the existing app design.
